summary.intent: Land class-method member blocks in monokl (split across PRs #64, #65, #66), then address two medium Entire findings on trail/change #38 (PR #66) and continue with features and cleanup.
summary.outcome: Reproduced both findings on the #66 branch, fixed them test-first (decorator-line hits now show the matching text; the ownership rule no longer excludes a block on a size tie), updated the README and added a changeset. All 689 tests passed, coverage was 97.53%, and the harness was unchanged (56/59, 59/59, 14/18). The fixes were committed, but the push is not confirmed in the transcript.

repo: Entire Gates fails on PRs #64 and #65 only because no reviewer has approved the trail; its checks and findings gates pass, so an agent cannot clear it.
Monokl PRs are developed in worktrees under .claude/worktrees/agent-*, and the local gate is just lint/test/doc-check/deny/machete/check-drift/changesets/coverage.
rg-compare harness baselines are 56/59 declaration-in-top-3, 59/59 declaration-in-output and 14/18 question answer-file-in-top-3. Any change that moves these needs scrutiny.
Each user-facing change needs a changeset in .changeset/, and the README sentence describing snippet behaviour has to be kept in sync with the code.
Member blocks carry a `parent` column. The dedup rule exempts a member only against the parentless block that strictly encloses it, and a hit line goes to the smallest block containing it.
OXC's ArrowFunctionExpression.body is an enum, so the span has to come from GetSpan.
docs/architecture/core-types.md still shows CodeBlock without the new `parent` field.

code.finding: The ownership rule excluded a block on a size tie. It should exclude a block only when another matching block is strictly nested inside it.
snippet() dropped the block's first line whenever a signature existed. That is wrong for decorated members, because the signature excludes decorators. It now needs a signature-coverage check.
The ownership property test was rewritten for the new strict-nesting rule, and an end-to-end expectation was corrected.

workflow: Verify subagent reports independently (CI state, findings sweep) before summarizing them.
Reproduce a finding on the branch first, write failing tests next, confirm they fail for the right reason, and only then fix.
Mutation-check proptests and run the full local gate, including the harness and coverage, before pushing.
Rerunning the whole test suite after a rule change exposed four dependent tests that needed their expectations updated.
